proposed.text: Under Section 605.8, what is required for wood used in permanent construction and located nearer than 150 mm to earth?

options.text: Treated wood or wood of natural resistance to decay, unless the checked slab/membrane protected condition applies
Any lumber if it is visually graded
No treatment if the member is painted
Only species listed in a stress-group table

rationale.correct: Section 605.8 requires treated wood or wood of natural resistance to decay for permanent wood located nearer than 150 mm to earth, with a protected slab/membrane exception.
